verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the /stages endpoint, which returns account-level recruitment pipeline stages defined in recruiting preferences. That is an adjacent pipeline feature, not a per-role interview plan. Nothing in the pack documents question banks, per-interviewer focus areas, or reusable interview plans attached to roles, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
